idea: an app to track my daily water intake

verdict.quote: The Water Tracker App That Builds A Daily Habit

gaps.gap: User cannot pay to remove ads because the app doesn’t recognize their Google account password.
gaps.quote: The app works fine, it very simple, but I can’t manage to pay the 1€ option to remove ads, the app asks me for my Google account password and doesn’t recognise it when I give it 🤷

gaps.gap: Price increased to over five times the original cost.
gaps.quote: Over five times how much it used to cost.

gaps.gap: Recommends a one‑time purchase alternative instead of this app.
gaps.quote: I would now recommend an alternative application that is bought once if you find it instead of this one.

gaps.gap: The app lacks a camera/barcode scanning integration to automatically add drinks from bottle labels
gaps.quote: I’d like to see an integration into the camera where you could just scan the nutritional facts on the back of the bottle
gaps.product: My Water: Daily Drink Tracker App

gaps.gap: The minimum age requirement of 14 is considered too high by some users
gaps.quote: why can’t it be a little younger
gaps.product: My Water: Daily Drink Tracker App

gaps.gap: Only water, coffee, and tea can be logged for free; other drinks like smoothies require payment
gaps.quote: When I try to put a smoothie on it, it says I have to pay for it
gaps.product: My Water: Daily Drink Tracker App

gaps.gap: The app resets the user’s weight to the default 107 lbs.
gaps.quote: the app resets your weight to the default 107lbs!
gaps.product: My Water: Daily Drink Tracker App

gaps.gap: Beverage choices are calculated incorrectly, misleading water content
gaps.quote: But some of the different types of beverage choices can be misleading with how it calculates the water content.
gaps.product: My Water: Daily Drink Tracker App

gaps.gap: The app lacks separate totals for fluid intake and water intake
gaps.quote: I wish this app had both the total amount of fluid intake along with the total water intake.
gaps.product: My Water: Daily Drink Tracker App

gaps.quote: Additionally, editing my log of drinks isn’t as easy as it could be.
gaps.product: My Water: Daily Drink Tracker App

gaps.gap: Changing a drink’s volume requires deleting and re‑adding it
gaps.quote: Sometimes I just want to edit a drink’s volume but that would require having to delete it entirely and reentering the whole thing.
gaps.product: My Water: Daily Drink Tracker App

gaps.quote: Every time I try to open the app, it crashes and won’t open.
gaps.product: My Water: Daily Drink Tracker App

gaps.gap: Tracking wasn't working for a few days, causing disruption
gaps.quote: The few days the tracking wasn't working was hugely disruptive to me.
gaps.product: My Water: Daily Drink Tracker App

gaps.gap: The app sometimes double tracks entries when using the quick/recent log buttons instead of the orange plus sign.
gaps.quote: the only thing I don't like is sometimes it double tracks what you track namely when you use the quick/recent log buttons rather than the orange plus sign.

gaps.gap: The app returns to the "let's get started" menu on each launch, resetting alarms and progress.
gaps.quote: Installed on my new phone and every time I open it's on the 'let's get started' menu.

angle.title: Robust editing & age‑flexible onboarding
angle.idea: Allow in‑place editing of logged drinks with an undo button and volume adjuster, and lower the minimum age to 13 with parental‑control options, addressing complaints 5,10,11.
